name: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory: Instrumentation and Online Systems
notes: Journal reference JINST 12 P03012 (2017) as listed on the arXiv abstract page; the publisher DOI was not read from a fetched source and is not recorded.

summary.plain: The reference paper describing how IceCube is built and run: the sensors, the cables, the drilling, and the computers that decide which flashes of light to keep.
summary.technical: IceCube instrumentation and online systems paper: DOM design, production and calibration, cable systems, computing, drilling and deployment methodology, triggering and filtering. Reports 98.4% of deep-ice DOMs operating and ~99% detector uptime. Published as JINST 12 (2017) P03012.
